svg.title: Jenkins CI/CD Pipeline — Java Maven App with Nexus and Docker Hub
svg.text: Jenkins CI/CD Pipeline — Java Maven App
GitHub → Jenkins → Maven → Docker → Nexus + Docker Hub → Deploy on EC2
writes Java app · pom.xml · Dockerfile · Jenkinsfile
git add . → git commit → git push
AWS EC2 Server — Jenkins + Nexus on same machine
Both running as Docker containers · connected via jenkins-nexus-network
jenkins/jenkins:lts · volumes: jenkins_home + docker.sock + docker binary
docker build -t java-maven-app:1.0 . · FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre-alpine · COPY ./target/*.jar /usr/app/
Jenkins SSHs to dev server → pulls image → restarts containers
success ✅ image pushed · failure ❌ check logs · always: cleanup
pipeline { stages { Checkout · Test · Build · DockerBuild · PushNexus · PushDockerHub · Deploy } }
Jenkins deploys here via SSH + docker compose up -d
git push → webhook → Jenkins: checkout → mvn test → mvn package → docker build → push Nexus + DockerHub → deploy
Jenkins + Nexus on same EC2 · jenkins-nexus-network · DockerHub: ighojohn/demo-app · May 2026
